title: The leak solution. A must if you use pads
text: The leak solution. A must if you use pads. These are the most incredible things invented for dogs who potty indoors.  I've used potty pads for years. I have had little dogs for years. 2 1/2 to 12 pounds. Even these small dogs pee through the pads, or they pee on the edge, and it runs underneath.  It's constant pick-up the pad and mop underneath. I even have separate Swiffer mops for this purpose. I was afraid when I got this that my dog, who's afraid of everything would not get on it. I've bought others that were hard plastic and had that problem. From the first day she used it, and it kept the urine contained. I think she realy likes it better because she knows exactly where to go. She was a retired breeder dg I got when she was 7 years old. so potty training, even letting her go outside has been a struggle.  She was used to going on the floor and now that's a no, no? She had never had her feet on grass, so it was all new. I was so please I have purchased 3. 2 for the laundry room and ne for the den, or overflow area as I call it.  She won't use the laundry room if the washer or dryer are going, or if I'm cleaning in there.  If you read this, then you are searching for a solution. This is it. I've tried just about every pad out there looking for the one that doesn't leak. I have 4 different brands right now. The solution is this pad. It doesn't matter what potty pads you use with this; they will not leak onto your floor. Just mop or dry the pad and you're good to go.  Saves time. labor, and $$.
